# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a public library of practical reflection resources for people and the AI assistants they choose to use. It publishes short CBT-inspired cards, plain-language learning guides, printable browser worksheets, structured public data, review metadata, language-status metadata, public agent evals, reproducible non-model baselines, held-out challenge cases, a provenance-first model-run protocol, an isolated provider execution path, citation metadata, and versioned portable agent instructions. The original CBT Cards mobile app remains documented as a separate product surface. CBT Cards is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

## Public toolkit corpus

- Toolkit landing page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/
- Review-status page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/review-status/
- Machine-readable review overlay: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
- Cards index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/cards/
- Metaphors index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/metaphors/
- Protocol records index: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/protocols/
- Source metadata and pinned corpus version: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-source.json
- The related source corpus contains 115 English records: 77 cards, 23 metaphors, and 15 protocols.
- Any source record not explicitly listed in the review overlay defaults to unreviewed and source-only.
- reviewed_for_publication means editorial/safety review for website publication, not clinical validation or proof of efficacy.

## Languages

- Human-readable language status: https://cbt-cards.github.io/languages/
- Locale registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/locales.json
- Translation overlays: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/translations.jsonl
- English (`en`) is the canonical source locale for the current curated knowledge dataset.
- Russian (`ru`) is a pilot locale. All 12 records in the current curated knowledge set have machine-readable drafts; none is human-reviewed or published as localized CBT Cards content yet.
- Records marked `machine_draft`, `unreviewed`, and `not_published` are development data, not official published CBT Cards translations.
- German (`de`) is planned and currently has no translation records.
- A localized record is official published CBT Cards content only when its translation, review, publication status, and canonical URL explicitly say so.
- Published localized resources use `https://cbt-cards.github.io/<locale>/resources/<resource_id>/` and are generated only from reviewed published translation records.

## Agent evaluation research

- Human-readable research page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/
- Starter evaluation cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals.jsonl
- Held-out challenge cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals-challenge.jsonl
- Starter deterministic runs: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-eval-runs.jsonl
- Held-out deterministic challenge runs: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-eval-challenge-runs.jsonl
- Evaluation case schema: https://cbt-cards.github.io/schemas/agent-eval-case-v1.schema.json
- Reproducible baseline runner: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_eval_baselines.py
- The starter set contains 24 cases across retrieval, learning, worksheets, localization, publication boundaries, privacy, and safety.
- `deterministic-contract-router-v1` reaches 24/24 routes on the friendly starter set but only 1/12 on the separately authored held-out challenge set, with 0/10 challenge target selections, 0/1 locale behaviors, and 1/3 boundary routes.
- Challenge dataset SHA-256: `f20bbc8562315de235fe6b935b17be8eeaa41d604b222c91904618658b2c0407`.
- If a runner, prompt, model, or adapter is tuned on the 12 challenge cases, this challenge generation is no longer held out for that system.
- Deterministic baseline scores are not evidence of general assistant or model quality.

## Real model-run protocol

- Protocol v1: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/MODEL_RUN_PROTOCOL.md
- Fixed model-run prompt v1: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/model-run-prompt-v1.txt
- Model-response contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/schemas/agent-model-response-v1.schema.json
- Model-run contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/schemas/agent-model-run-v1.schema.json
- Isolated OpenAI Responses API generator: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_model_openai.py
- Separate execution scorer wrapper: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/score_model_execution.py
- Deterministic post-generation evaluator: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/evaluate_model_run.py
- Publication-candidate provenance gate: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/check_model_run_candidate.py
- Generation and scoring are separate stages. During generation the model receives `user_message`, the fixed evaluation prompt, normal CBT Cards skill/runtime instructions, and public CBT Cards sources, but benchmark-only expected fields remain hidden.
- The OpenAI adapter uses strict structured output, records `store: false`, and restricts web search to `cbt-cards.github.io`.
- A model execution records prompt, dataset, current skill, response, model/runtime, and evaluator provenance before it can be considered for publication.
- A manual GitHub Actions workflow can generate starter or challenge artifacts in a fresh process using repository secret `OPENAI_API_KEY`; it uploads execution, raw-response, and scored-run artifacts and does not self-publish them.
- The v1 deterministic evaluator scores route, exact target IDs, locale behavior, and boundary routing. It does not automatically score prose quality, `expected_checks`, or prohibited claims.
- CI uses synthetic fixtures only to validate isolation and the post-generation scoring/candidate pipeline. Fixtures are not model benchmark results.
- No LLM or hosted-assistant score is currently claimed.

## Portable agent skill

- Latest mutable skill v1.7.0: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/SKILL.md
- Skill manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/manifest.json
- Backward-compatible immutable v1.7.0: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/v1.7.0/SKILL.md
- Strict Agent Skills distribution v1.7.0: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/v1.7.0/cbt-cards/SKILL.md
- Installation notes for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and generic Agent Skills clients: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/INSTALL.md
- v1.7.0 uses the portable Agent Skills frontmatter field set, stores version in string-valued `metadata.version`, and keeps runtime-specific installation instructions outside the portable core.
- The mutable alias, compatibility immutable URL, and strict portable distribution contain identical v1.7.0 skill content.
- Historical skill releases remain unchanged at their original URLs.

## Citation

- Citation metadata: https://cbt-cards.github.io/CITATION.cff
- The file uses Citation File Format 1.2.0 and describes CBT Cards as a dataset authored by MetalHatsCats.
- No DOI or project-wide semantic version is currently claimed; add them only when actually assigned/released.

For CBT Cards-owned formats, use the versioned contracts listed in schemas/index.json. Some schemas are interface-only contracts until a real public instance exists; do not invent an instance merely because a schema is discoverable.

Website, dataset, translation, schema, worksheet, research, and agent-skill changes are separate from mobile-app releases. Do not infer an Android/iOS app version from public-site release metadata.
